notice: AGENT-PROPOSED AND UNREVIEWED. These labels were proposed by an AI agent from small samples fetched on 2026-10-09 (UTC). They are NOT a ground truth until the project owner approves them under the labelling protocol in .kiro/specs/poi-source-integration/design.md. Until then do not import this file in any test, do not use it to tune thresholds, and do not compute or report precision, recall or any other accuracy figure against it. The entries were hand-picked to illustrate cases; they are not a random sample and cannot support any rate estimate even after approval.
proposedBy: AI agent (Claude), from the saved samples only
metricsPolicy: Metrics (precision, recall, false-merge rate) are only ever reported against owner-approved labels, drawn from a seeded random sample of candidate pairs. This file is neither. No such figure has been computed anywhere.
classSemantics: proposedClass is the strength-of-evidence class that the rule table in design.md assigns to the two records shown, independent of whether either source is admitted. proposedRelationHolds is the separate truth proposal (yes, no, part-of, undetermined, no-counterpart-in-sample) the owner is asked to confirm or correct.

relationVocabulary.same-entity: The two records describe the same real-world place.
relationVocabulary.same-physical-exit: Two records inside one source that might describe one physical exit (intra-source duplicate check).
relationVocabulary.exit-belongs-to-station-footprint: An exit point and a station outline: membership, not identity.
relationVocabulary.intra-source-sibling: Two records of one source that might be mistaken for each other.

classVocabulary.verified: Two independent sources agree on identity through a shared key or exact name AND tight geometry, uniquely (rule ids R-VER-*).
classVocabulary.rule-supported: No shared key, but one named rule in design.md is satisfied by a unique mutual candidate (rule ids R-RS-*).
classVocabulary.ambiguous: More than one candidate, conflicting channels, granularity mismatch, or too little evidence. Never auto-merged (rule ids R-AMB-*).
classVocabulary.unmatched: No candidate in the other sampled source satisfies even the weakest rule (R-UNM-NO-CANDIDATE). It says nothing about whether the place exists.
classVocabulary.rejected: A candidate that passed blocking and failed a hard-negative rule (rule ids R-REJ-*). Kept so it is never re-proposed.

ruleVocabulary.R-AMB-CHANNEL-CONFLICT: Name exact but geometry beyond the wide band, or key conflict.
ruleVocabulary.R-AMB-EXTENSION: One name strictly extends the other while the shorter-named record is already taken by a stronger partner: a sub-area, or a different place that no rule can tell apart.
ruleVocabulary.R-AMB-MULTI: At least two equal-strength candidates in the same tier (for name extensions the count is taken within the block radius, not the wide band).
ruleVocabulary.R-REJ-DOMINATED: A record of the pair is already taken by a stronger verified or rule-supported partner, and this pair is only a spelling variant, a subtype variant or a different name.
ruleVocabulary.R-RS-EXACT-WIDE: Name exact, geometry in the wide band only.
ruleVocabulary.R-RS-NEAR-GEO: Name near (spelling, strict extension or subtype-subset), geometry within the tight or wide band.
ruleVocabulary.R-UNM-NO-CANDIDATE: No candidate passes the minimum predicate in the other sampled source.
ruleVocabulary.R-VER-NAME-GEO: No key; name exact AND geometry within the tight band, unique mutual candidate.
